name: Reinquarantination
source:
Karl the caterpillar has to go into isolation for his pupation days. 

He is excited starts out optimistic, but soon the days become indistinguishable inside his chrysalis. 

His friends seem to behave weirdly too and with the distance, their relationship becomes more evident. Who are they really? And who is Karl himself?

Join him on his way to reincarnation during  quarantine!
